name: OJ
source:
A spy of the HH brothers who has infiltrated the Hong Kong police.
According to him, he contributes to society in this twisted way because he is "too smart to be a good person at heart".
He sees things from a distance and uses his calm judgment to move others like pieces on a board.
He enjoys playing score-attack games with Shawn and Fatso, whom he met at a video game arcade.
He asks Shawn to analyze certain data.
